summary: Full backend regression after the pure modularization refactor (server.py -> deps.py / ai_extractor.py / pdf_builder.py). Created /app/backend/tests/test_iter13_refactor_regression.py (60 pytest tests) covering every endpoint group against the public preview URL with httpOnly-cookie auth: auth (login/me/refresh/logout/401/bad-password/brute-force lockout 429), dashboard/projects/project-detail/404, clients CRUD (create->GET->patch->archive + 422 validation), templates list/get/analyze, documents list/download/upload, defects CRUD + attach-survey-photo + AI auto-match-photos, site-conditions vision detect + PUT, heritage lookup, Google Solar lookup + PV apply (real key configured and working), measure evidence photo upload/delete, project mutations (field patch allow-list, custom sections CRUD, ventilation PUT, floorplan upload + markers PUT, item confirm / confirm-all, apply-client-library, photos PUT, extract-photos validation, datasheets/parse), and pack.html + pack.pdf. RESULT: 60/60 passed, 0 5xx in backend logs during the run. PDF pack verified end-to-end with pymupdf: 12 Marsh End = 101 pages / 10.7MB; RTF-2026-0170 (solar+heritage) = 173 pages / 31MB; RTF-2026-0140 = 78 pages. pack.html 183KB-5.3MB. No import-wiring or behavioural regression found from the module split; no duplicate function definitions remain between server.py and the new modules and all four modules import cleanly.

minor.issue: get_object() is called synchronously inside the async route (server.py ~line 1398) instead of via asyncio.to_thread like everywhere else - blocking object-store IO on the event loop; noticeable when downloading large survey PDFs/photos concurrently with a pack render.

No existence check: returns 200 {'status':'analyzing'} for any tid (including non-existent) and fires asyncio.create_task with no error surface, so analysis failures are silent (only visible in logs).
_seed_clients() runs a count_documents on every request plus a full projects scan for counts - avoidable per-request work on a hot list endpoint.

WeasyPrint logs repeated 'Anchor defined twice: gnd/dots/hatch/grain' warnings (duplicate SVG element ids emitted per page in pdf_builder) plus ignored text-shadow/box-shadow properties. Cosmetic/log noise only - PDF renders correctly.

action_items: Wrap get_object() in asyncio.to_thread inside GET /api/documents/{doc_id}/download (only remaining sync-blocking storage call).
Add a 404 existence check to POST /api/templates/{tid}/analyze and surface background analysis errors on the template record.
Optional: split pdf_builder.py (2441 lines) further (e.g. pack sections vs solar/heritage vs PV autofill) - it still exceeds the 700-line guideline, as do ai_extractor.py (1278) and server.py (1491).
critical_code_review_comments: Refactor verified clean: no symbol defined in both server.py and deps/ai_extractor/pdf_builder (comm on def lists returned nothing), all modules import standalone, ruff lint clean on /app/backend/*.py.
pdf_builder.py is 2441 lines and ai_extractor.py 1278 - the split fixed server.py but two of the three new modules still breach the 700-line guideline.
server.py POST and PUT /projects/{id}/defects duplicate the same field-normalisation block; extract to a helper.

POST /projects/{id}/extract-photos inserts documents with both '_id' and 'id' set to the same uuid while every other insert lets Mongo generate _id - inconsistent, harmless today but easy to trip over.
